name: PoolPartyBof
help: Inject shellcode by abusing Windows Thread Pools (does not sanity-check)
long_help: Inject-only. Packs pid, delay, drip, drip_ms, then shellcode (four ints always). A 32-bit or layout-mismatched PID can crash the target — run poolparty-sanity first if unsure. This bundle ships variant 8 (TP_TIMER). Use the Cobalt Strike CNA or Havoc script for variants 4-8.

arguments.name: delay
arguments.desc: Seconds to wait between major API steps (0 = none). Always packed.

arguments.name: drip
arguments.desc: 1 = page-sized drip alloc/write of shellcode, 0 = one-shot. Always packed.

arguments.name: drip_ms
arguments.desc: Milliseconds to wait between drip pages (0 = none, capped at 1000). Always packed.
